HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness. ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness. .

2. Which response best shows understanding of Panch- mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Say Panch- mahabhoot has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Panch- mahabhoot with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Panch- mahabhoot.
   D. Use Panch- mahabhoot to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Indian Traditional Calendar? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Indian Traditional Calendar.
   B. Apply the teaching of Indian Traditional Calendar with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Indian Traditional Calendar has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Indian Traditional Calendar to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Aspects of integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Aspects of integrity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Aspects of integrity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Aspects of integrity.
   D. Say Aspects of integrity has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o.
   B. Use Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Dainik Prarthana? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Dainik Prarthana with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Dainik Prarthana has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dainik Prarthana.
   D. Use Dainik Prarthana to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str? (1 mark)
   A. Use Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str.
   D. Say Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str has no place in daily life.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

10. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   C. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Social and National Festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Social and National Festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Social and National Festivals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Social and National Festivals has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social and National Festivals.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues for righteousness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Virtues for righteousness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues for righteousness.
   C. Apply the teaching of Virtues for righteousness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Virtues for righteousness has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of integrity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
